reason: B keeps the same reproductive-behaviour, GPCR peptide-hormone/feeding, stress-neuropeptide and GH/prolactin/HPA contexts in 14 themes, whereas A repeats near-identical glucagon/calcitonin/ghrelin and orexin/behaviour themes many times; A's only extra is a smooth-muscle/tachykinin facet that does not justify its clutter.

Both show the myogenesis/NMJ, dystroglycan O-mannosylation, basement membrane, Hh/Slit-Robo and broad glycosylation contexts, but B does it in 9 themes, merging basement membrane with DGC glycosylation, while A adds redundant intermediate and near-duplicate large glycosylation/lysosome themes.

A has dedicated propionyl-CoA/methylmalonyl-CoA/cobalamin themes that capture where valine's carbon skeleton actually goes, while B only buries that facet in a 91-member catch-all; this is worth A's extra redundancy.

Both cover pyrimidine catabolism, purine deoxynucleoside/PNP-ADA degradation, NUDT sanitization, salvage and de novo synthesis, but B spreads them over 35 heavily overlapping themes and adds an off-target folate/methionine theme, while A presents them in 17.

The two sets cover the same nephron-patterning, MET/renal-vesicle, ureteric-bud, tubule-segment, whole-kidney and branching-epithelia levels, but B repeats them as 24 near-identical kidney subsets, while A gives a clean 12-step ladder.

B covers the GH/leptin JAK-STAT core, IL-6-family, EPO/STAT5 haematopoietic cytokines, thyroid, HPA/feeding, steroidogenesis, gonadal and pregnancy/placental contexts in 15 themes, while A repeats the GH/IGF/IL-6 and gonadal themes many times with little added meaning.
